PC12-002.name: Ayanami Rei ［First Children］
PC12-002.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Purple Core][Red Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
You can summon a "NERV" family card with reduction symbols of two or more colors from your Hand, treating all reduction symbols as fulfilled. When you've done so, after this effect resolves, summon this Mirage without paying the cost.

[During Brave]
While this Spirit is Cost 7 or less, this Brave is fixed at zero symbols.

PC12-X03.name: Evangelion Unit-00 Kai
PC12-X03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can summon/deploy one "NERV" family card with reduction symbols of two colors or more from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost. If it's the Attack Step, change the "one" written on this effect to "up to two".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacka)
Send every core from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. This effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Heavy Armor].

PC12-X02.name: Evangelion Unit-01
PC12-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Treat this Spirit's color as colorless, and you can destroy three opposing Spirits/Ultimates with two cores or less on them. Then, if it’s the Attack Step, besides the [Soul Core], send up to two cores from your Trash to any of your Spirits.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can’t Stack) When the attack of your originally Cost 6 or more “Evangelion” reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to the Trash.

PC12-X01.name: Evangelion Unit 02
PC12-X01.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate Attacks]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If you control any "NERV" family Nexus/Mirage, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two symbols or less. Then, if it's the Attack Step, draw two cards.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

PC12-003.name: Ikari Shinji ［Third Children］
PC12-003.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

[During Brave]
Treat this Spirit as having [Soul Core] on it.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Send every core from an opposing Cost 4 or less Grandwalker Nexus to the Void. Or, send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve. If this Spirit is Cost 10 or more, this effect sends +2 cores to the Reserve.

PC12-005.name: Moment and Heart Together
PC12-005.effect:
(Once per turn: same name) During either Attack Step, when your "Evangelion" with reduction symbols of two or more colors is summoned, you can return this card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Flash]
During this turn, you can attack simultaneously with two "Evangelion" that have the same cost. The opponent can block one of them, but the other can't be blocked (Both battles conclude at the same time).

PC12-001.name: Sohryu Asuka Langley ［Second Children］
PC12-001.effect:
This Brave in Spirit condition can't attack/block.

(Once Per Turn: Same Name) During either Attack Step, when your "Evangelion" is summoned, this card in Hand can be summoned without paying the cost.

[During Brave]
Treat this Spirit as having the [Soul Core] on it.

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can draw a card. Then, by discarding a card from your Hand, draw a card.

PC12-004.name: To Shinji-Kun
PC12-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "NERV" family card with reduction symbols of two colors or more to the Hand, or deploy a "NERV" family Nexus card with reduction symbols of two colors or more, treating all reduction symbols as fulfilled. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Increase the number of cards you draw by +1. After you draw, discard a card from your Hand.
